This unmodified test fixture is the checksum-pinned AWS asm-exec source used by the host bootstrap.

Source: https://github.com/aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/blob/171d4fba3bc404da3473f323c3e293b4a989f089/plugins/aws-core/skills/aws-secrets-manager/references/asm-exec

SHA-256: d55eb38ad33a5b76f584ca180f633ecc120cf39b8fd29427ffbe11a8fbf19556

It is used offline to apply the real bootstrap patch and exercise the installed resolver with synthetic MCP responses. No AWS credentials or network are used.
